title: Signature 14 · Muscle Hourglass · Irezumi Cherry · Desert Dawn
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her mid 30s, long glossy black waves, pulled over one shoulder so the back is uncovered.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. Muscular hourglass BBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 300 pounds — a gigantic heavy bust, broad rounded strong shoulders, enormous thick arms with big defined biceps, a clearly cinched waist that is narrow only in contrast to the enormous bust and the very wide heavy hips, a firm flat stomach with no visible abs, colossal thighs with powerful defined quads, massive calves. Feminine face, warm smile, not masculine, no bodybuilder look, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body Japanese irezumi body painting painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. A bright indigo and white swirling wave ground with vivid pink, vermilion, and gold cherry blossom branches, one continuous design flowing diagonally across the torso. The waves and blossoms wrap the swell of the biceps and quads and narrow across the cinched waistline. A large continuous design spreads across the whole back and down over the hips and the backs of the thighs. Not black shading, no dragons, no koi. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing with her back three-quarters to the camera, looking back over her shoulder with a warm smile, one arm hanging away from the body, the painted broad back, cinched waist, and wide hips fully visible.

Footwear: Extremely high pink lacquer platform stiletto mules. Nails: extra long stiletto, pink.

Background & Lighting: Pale golden desert dunes at dawn under a soft white sky, no buildings, no temples, the background much lighter than her body, warm low sunlight carving the inward curve of the waist and the swell of the biceps and quads, making the glossy colors gleam, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
